concerns.text: The ‘External Validation’ step samples 200 distinct alloys from the same OQMD dataset used for training. Because both training and external sets originate from the same source, they share the same measurement protocols, feature distributions, and potential systematic biases. This does not constitute a truly independent external validation and may lead to over‑optimistic performance estimates. A more scientifically sound approach would use a separate, independently sourced dataset (e.g., a verified Materials Project release with magnetic properties) for external validation, or at minimum ensure that any preprocessing (e.g., scaling, imputation) is fit only on the training split to avoid data leakage.
